mekayis.metin: (مَوَمَ) الْمِيمُ وَالْوَاوُ وَالْمِيمُ كَلِمَتَانِ مُتَبَايِنَتَانِ جِدًّا: الْمُومُ: الْبِرْسَامُ، وَمِيمَ الرَّجُلُ فَهُوَ مَمُومٌ، وَالْمَوْمَاةُ: الْمَفَازَةُ الْوَاسِعَةُ الْمَلْسَاءُ، جَمْعُهَا مَوَامٍ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Phoenician 𐤌‬𐤌 (m‬m‬ /⁠mēm⁠/). Doublet of ماء (māʔ).
g: Name of the 24th letter of the Arabic alphabet (م / م), representing the sound /m/.

kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
English mimemeclip.
English memebor.
Arabic ميم
Borrowed from English meme, clipping of mimeme.
Derived from the passive participle verb form I of the root ي م ن (y m n). See also يَمِين (yamīn, “right, right-hand”).

Etymology tree
Miami Mayaimibor.
English Miamibor.
Arabic ميامي
Borrowed from English Miami.
g: Miami (a city, the county seat of Miami-Dade County, Florida)
